mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 65 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall. Under the Waxing Crescent moon tonight, look for the space station pass starting at 7:40 PM as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward Madison near Home Depot, reaching high in the sky.

In city news, police were called to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th regarding a residential burglary. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody following the incident, and he faces charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

There is plenty to do in Verona. We have the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival happening today, along with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and trivia events are scheduled for Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On September 10th, the Verona Police Department responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way involving a firearm. The suspect was treated for an injury before being booked into the Dane County Jail.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Culver's is open right now and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
